verses.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.pt: O primeiro pacto também tinha ordenanças de culto, e o santuário terrestre.
verses.en_web: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.
verses.en_bbe: Now the first agreement had its rules of worship, and a holy order.

verses.en: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.pt: Pois um tabernáculo foi preparado, o primeiro, em que havia o candelabro, a mesa, e os pães da proposição. Esse é chamado o Santo Lugar.
verses.en_web: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread; which is called the Holy Place.
verses.en_bbe: For the first Tent was made ready, having in it the vessels for the lights and the table and the ordering of the bread; and this is named the holy place.

verses.en: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.pt: Mas após o segundo véu estava o tabernáculo que se chama Santo dos Santos;
verses.en_web: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
verses.en_bbe: And inside the second veil was the place which is named the Holy of holies;

verses.en: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.pt: que tinha o incensário de ouro, e a arca do pacto, toda coberta de ouro. Nela estavam: o vaso de ouro contendo o maná, a vara de Arão que florescera, e as tábuas do pacto.
verses.en_web: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
verses.en_bbe: Having a vessel of gold in it for burning perfumes, and the ark of the agreement, which was covered with gold and which had in it a pot made of gold for the manna, and Aaron's rod which put out buds, and the stones with the writing of the agreement;

verses.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.pt: E acima dela, os querubins de glória, que faziam sombra ao propiciatório. Acerca dessas coisas não é oportuno agora falar em detalhes.
verses.en_web: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
verses.en_bbe: And over it were the winged ones of glory with their wings covering the mercy-seat; about which it is not possible now to say anything in detail.

verses.en: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
verses.pt: Ora, estando estas coisas assim preparadas, os sacerdotes entram a todo tempo no primeiro tabernáculo, para cumprirem as atividades de culto.
verses.en_web: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
verses.en_bbe: Now while these things were in existence, the priests went into the first Tent at all times, for prayer and the making of offerings.

verses.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.pt: Mas no segundo, somente o sumo sacerdote, uma vez por ano, não sem sangue, que oferece por si mesmo, e pelos pecados de ignorância do povo.
verses.en_web: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the errors of the people.
verses.en_bbe: But only the high priest went into the second, once a year, not without making an offering of blood for himself and for the errors of the people:

verses.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.pt: Desta maneira, o Espírito Santo dá a entender que o caminho para o Santuário não havia sido revelado enquanto o primeiro Tabernáculo ainda estava de pé.
verses.en_web: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing;
verses.en_bbe: The Holy Spirit witnessing by this that the way into the holy place had not at that time been made open, while the first Tent was still in being;

verses.en: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.pt: Esse é uma figura para o tempo presente, em que são oferecidos ofertas e sacrifícios que não podem, quanto a consciência, tornar perfeito a quem faz o serviço;
verses.en_web: which is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect;
verses.en_bbe: And this is an image of the present time; when the offerings which are given are not able to make the heart of the worshipper completely clean,

verses.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
verses.pt: pois consistem somente em comidas e bebidas, e vários lavamentos, e ordenanças para o corpo, que foram impostas até o tempo da correção.
verses.en_web: being only (with meats and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
verses.en_bbe: Because they are only rules of the flesh, of meats and drinks and washings, which have their place till the time comes when things will be put right.

verses.en: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.pt: Mas quando veio Cristo, o Sumo Sacerdote dos bens futuros, por meio de um Tabernáculo maior e mais perfeito, não feito por mãos, isto é, não desta criação;
verses.en_web: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
verses.en_bbe: But now Christ has come as the high priest of the good things of the future, through this greater and better Tent, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this world,

verses.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.pt: ele entrou de uma vez por todas no Santuário, e obteve uma redenção eterna, não pelo sangue de bodes e bezerros, mas sim, pelo seu próprio sangue.
verses.en_web: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
verses.en_bbe: And has gone once and for ever into the holy place, having got eternal salvation, not through the blood of goats and young oxen, but through his blood.

verses.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.pt: Pois, se o sangue de touros e bodes, e as cinzas de uma novilha espalhadas sobre os imundos, santifica para a purificação do corpo,
verses.en_web: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh:
verses.en_bbe: For if the blood of goats and oxen, and the dust from the burning of a young cow, being put on the unclean, make the flesh clean:

verses.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.pt: quanto mais o sangue do Cristo que, pelo Espírito eterno, ofereceu a si mesmo, imaculado, a Deus, purificará a vossa consciência das obras mortas, para servirdes ao Deus vivo!
verses.en_web: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
verses.en_bbe: How much more will the blood of Christ, who, being without sin, made an offering of himself to God through the Holy Spirit, make your hearts clean from dead works to be servants of the living God?

verses.en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.pt: E por isso ele é o Mediador de um Novo Testamento, a fim de que, com a ocorrência de uma morte para redenção das transgressões sob o primeiro Testamento, os que foram chamados recebam a promessa da herança eterna.
verses.en_web: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: And for this cause it is through him that a new agreement has come into being, so that after the errors under the first agreement had been taken away by his death, the word of God might have effect for those who were marked out for an eternal heritage.

verses.en: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.pt: Pois onde há um testamento, é necessário que ocorra a morte do testador;
verses.en_web: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
verses.en_bbe: Because where there is a testament, there has to be the death of the man who made it.

verses.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.pt: porque um testamento se confirma nos mortos, visto que não é válido enquanto o testador vive.
verses.en_web: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
verses.en_bbe: For a testament has effect after death; for what power has it while the man who made it is living?

verses.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
verses.pt: Por isso o primeiro testamento também não foi consagrado sem sangue;
verses.en_web: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
verses.en_bbe: So that even the first agreement was not made without blood.

verses.en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.pt: Porque, depois de Moisés haver pronunciado a todo o povo todo mandamento segundo a Lei, ele tomou o sangue de bezerros e de bodes, com água, lã purpúrea, e hissopo, e aspergiu, tanto o próprio livro, como todo o povo,
verses.en_web: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
verses.en_bbe: For when Moses had given all the rules of the law to the people, he took the blood of goats and young oxen, with water and red wool and hyssop, and put it on the book itself and on all the people,

verses.en: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.
verses.pt: dizendo: Este é o sangue do pacto que Deus ordenou para vós. Êxodo 24:8
verses.en_web: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, This blood is the sign of the agreement which God has made with you.

verses.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.pt: E semelhantemente aspergiu com o sangue o Tabernáculo, e todos os utensílios do serviço de culto.
verses.en_web: Moreover he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
verses.en_bbe: And the blood was put on the Tent and all the holy vessels in the same way.

verses.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.pt: Segundo a Lei, quase todas as coisas são purificadas com sangue, e sem derramamento de sangue não há perdão de pecados.
verses.en_web: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
verses.en_bbe: And by the law almost all things are made clean with blood, and without blood there is no forgiveness.

verses.en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.pt: Portanto era necessário que os esboços das coisas que estão nos céus fossem purificados com esses sacrifícios; mas as próprias coisas celestiais, com sacrifícios melhores que esses.
verses.en_web: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause it was necessary to make the copies of the things in heaven clean with these offerings; but the things themselves are made clean with better offerings than these.

verses.en: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
verses.pt: Pois Cristo não entrou num santuário feito por mãos, mera figura do verdadeiro; mas sim, no próprio Céu, para agora comparecer por nós diante da face de Deus.
verses.en_web: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
verses.en_bbe: For Christ did not go into a holy place which had been made by men's hands as the copy of the true one; but he went into heaven itself, and now takes his place before the face of God for us.

verses.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.pt: Também não entrou para oferecer a si mesmo muitas vezes, como o sumo sacerdote entra a cada ano no santuário com sangue alheio;
verses.en_web: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
verses.en_bbe: And he did not have to make an offering of himself again and again, as the high priest goes into the holy place every year with blood which is not his;

verses.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.pt: (de outra maneira lhe seria necessário padecer muitas vezes desde a fundação do mundo), mas agora, no fim dos tempos, ele se manifestou de uma vez por todas para aniquilar o pecado pelo sacrifício de si mesmo.
verses.en_web: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.en_bbe: For then he would have undergone a number of deaths from the time of the making of the world: but now he has come to us at the end of the old order, to put away sin by the offering of himself.

verses.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.pt: E, como está ordenado aos seres humanos morrerem uma vez, e depois disso, o juízo,
verses.en_web: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
verses.en_bbe: And because by God's law death comes to men once, and after that they are judged;

verses.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.pt: assim também Cristo, que se ofereceu uma vez para tirar os pecados de muitos, aparecerá pela segunda vez, sem pecado, aos que o esperam, para a salvação.
verses.en_web: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, without sin, to those who are eagerly waiting for him for salvation.
verses.en_bbe: So Christ, having at his first coming taken on himself the sins of men, will be seen a second time, without sin, by those who are waiting for him, for their salvation.
